svg.text: DFF Stick Diagram — CLK inv (left) · logic row (top) · TG row (bottom)
CLK INV: N2f / P4f · 0.5 µm fingers (separate, taller strips)
Logic row: INV1 N2f/P4f · NOR1 N2f/P8f · INV2 N4f/P8f · NOR2 N4f/P16f — NOR: series PMOS share diffusion, parallel NMOS share the output diffusion
TG row: forward TG1/TG3 N2f/P4f · feedback TG2/TG4 N1f/P2f — adjacent TGs share diffusion at X, QM, Y
